zh-Hans: 用 Kimi 新建一个普通任务，再请它绘制一张图表。打开已有游戏，记录从点击「试玩」到出现标题画面的时间；在「调整按键位置」中连续拖动两个键，保存并重开试玩，检查位置和按键响应。
en-US: Start an ordinary task with Kimi, then ask it to create a chart. Open an existing game and time how long it takes to reach the title screen after tapping Play. In Arrange Keys, move two keys in succession, save, reopen the game and check their positions and responses.
